name: WPG Page Protection
author: David Powell

sections.description:
WPG Page Protection is a WordPress plugin that helps protect your website content by preventing unauthorized copying and screenshots. It provides various security features to maintain the integrity of your content.

Features

  • Disable right-click functionality
  • Prevent screenshots
  • Block keyboard shortcuts (Premium)
  • Disable inspect element (Premium)
  • Print screen protection (Premium)
  • Function keys control (Premium)
  • Advanced mouse protection (Premium)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the page-protection folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the settings under ‘Page Protection’ in your WordPress admin panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, Page Protection is designed to work with any WordPress theme.

Can I customize the warning message?

Yes, you can customize the warning message that appears when protected actions are attempted.
